### Log settings

The gateway reads these environment variables at startup:

Table (2 of 2 rows)
Location: Gateway operations > Upgrade the gateway > Log settings
[1] Variable: GATEWAY_LOG_LEVEL.
Default: info.
Description: Sets the log level. Use debug to log every request.
[2] Variable: GATEWAY_LOG_FORMAT.
Default: text.
Description: Sets the log format. Use json for log collectors.

Restart the gateway pod after you change a variable, because the gateway reads them only at startup.
